description: This pie chart illustrates a comparison between two categories, representing specific time durations and their relative proportions. The chart consists of a total of two slices. The larger slice, colored orange, is labeled "Reduction" and accounts for 60.9s, which corresponds to 69.92% of the total. The smaller slice, colored blue, is labeled "Efficient deployment" and represents 26.2s, or 30.08%. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the category labels are positioned just outside their respective segments, while the absolute time values and their corresponding percentages are displayed directly inside the slices. Visually, the blue "Efficient deployment" slice is emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the main body of the pie chart. The segments are visually distinct, with the larger orange segment naturally occupying the majority of the chart area.
